risk_note: RV2 (orders/**). Rights / punish import rows (BR-FUND-06 import-task detail, D10-152 ⑨; BR-FUND-02 PUNISH): the B1-09g row processors for kind=rights and punish locate the sub-order within the task's platform, refuse rows in order (invalid_row → platform_mismatch → sub_order_no_missing without expansion → order_not_found), filter by the [from, to) window on paid or received time (outside / no paid time → skipped_rows, received basis without a received time → received_at_missing), and write RIGHTS (status from the template column) / PUNISH (SUCCEEDED) only through B1-09c's rights.record inside the job's checkpoint transaction; duplicate → duplicate_rows (no second clawback), not_applicable → skipped_rows; yuan amounts to fen through packages/money (no floats); no rights port → task failed. The shared sheet reader now keeps xlsx ISO date cells (t="d" with a zone) as absolute instants (B1-09h money S2). Header templates still await the owner's samples (K-3); tests use synthetic headers. Codex was unavailable until 10-30, so tests and the money review ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
